title: Concept meta envelope
description: *.meta.yaml — the shared, Vadalog-shaped envelope for a logic/sql/cypher/python concept. The body (rules) lives in the sibling body file. Edges are derived from predicates, never written here.

conceptType.description: context and llm concepts use their own single-file forms (*.context.yaml / *.llm.md).

outputPredicate.description: The concept's output predicate (its lineage node name).

description.description: Human/agent-readable description (pulled from the server; optional when hand-authoring).

annotations.description: Verbatim server annotation columns preserved on pull (bind_annotations, param_annotations, post_annotations, model_annotation, mapping_annotations). The lossless capture apply consumes. Prefer the friendly `binds`/`fields` when hand-authoring.

input.description: External data bound into a predicate. A predicate produced by ANOTHER concept must NOT be bound here — that reference is a derived edge.

datasource.description: Name of a datasource file in datasources/, resolved at apply.

output.description: Where results are written. Empty/unbound => materialized by the engine.
